conclusion: On 2026-10-17 the OrcaSlicer remote had main as its default branch and no master. The reviewed ten-commit integration ending at 6d40ec93f6 preserves Inlong identity, adds lazy PNG/texture-picker loading, extended-length Windows archive paths and GUI layout fixes, and fixes empty support collections and misplaced tree extra walls. It removes the unconditional organic double-wall override above 100 mm while retaining local multi-island generation, normal contact-clearance and X2 fixes. Profiles and five protected support/X2 source files are unchanged. Windows Release builds and native regressions passed; all three supplied projects have identical complete ordered commands, annotated motion and emitted configuration to the latest fixed pre-merge candidate. Installed DLLs remain unchanged. An independent old-runtime GUI startup changed two preferences and added a log; those current changes were retained and backed up rather than overwritten. For native validation, use explicit test data directories, library/test targets and direct app linking to disposable output with references/build events disabled, avoiding portable-data reset targets. Interactive GUI/macOS behavior and Provider publication readiness were not established.
scope: Version-bound Windows integration of upstream main at 6d40ec93f6

verification.summary: 123 core cases / 8775 assertions and eight plugin cases / 33 assertions passed on the first candidate; the relevant source hashes remain identical. Eleven packaging contracts passed. The final affected support suite and all three supplied-project slices passed after the additional support commit. Raw logs, command/configuration comparisons and source hashes are retained. Existing compilation and initialization warning events are disclosed; no warning-free, interactive GUI, macOS, install or Provider release-readiness claim is made.
